newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish food 11-pct cheaper two yrs after EU entry.
newsitem.headline: Finnish food 11-pct cheaper two yrs after EU entry.

text.p: Finnish food prices were 11.2-percent cheaper in October-November than two years ago before Finland joined the European Union at the start of 1995, the National Consumer Administration said in a statement on Monday.
"Food prices are now on average 11.2-percent cheaper than two years ago before Finland became a member of the EU," it said.
Most of the fall had occurred during the first year of EU membership, it said, adding food prices had only fallen on average by 0.1 percent in the year from the autumn of 1995.
The administration surveyed food retail prices at 153 outlets of nation-wide super market chains. The survey was carried out in October-November. Price changes (pct):
